second_pass.method: 逐段通读整体交际动作及内部词块；回看未选段与已选段，补充解释、对比、条件、叙事、工作与生活结构。观众插话单独识别，分页断句核对连续原段。未用词表筛选代替通读。
second_pass.intentionally_omitted: 政治口号、人物与地名罗列、观众口号、单词义项、临时长比喻及无独立迁移价值的泛化碎片。候选表达不代表日常高频或已掌握。

items.chunk: wish each and every one of you ...
items.note: each and every 强调无一例外。
items.quote: As we begin this Fourth of July weekend, the First Lady and I would wish each and every one of you a very, very happy Independence Day. Thank you.

items.note: 官方本地可读层在 U.S. 前跨段；连续合并段3–4。
items.quote: Let us show our appreciation to the South Dakota Army and Air National Guard, and the U.S. Air Force for inspiring us with that magnificent display of American air power.

items.quote: There could be no better place to celebrate America's independence than beneath this magnificent, incredible, majestic mountain and monument to the greatest Americans who have ever lived.

items.quote: It was all made possible by the courage of 56 patriots who gathered in Philadelphia 244 years ago and signed the Declaration of Independence.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: These immortal words set in motion the unstoppable march of freedom.

items.note: 近 no room for，但此处 place 强调不属于该环境。
items.quote: This is the very definition of totalitarianism, and it is completely alien to our culture and our values, and it has absolutely no place in the United States of America.

items.quote: In so doing, they would destroy the very civilization that rescued billions from poverty, disease, violence, and hunger and that lifted humanity to new heights of achievement, discovery, and progress.

items.quote: That is why I am deploying Federal law enforcement to protect our monuments, arrest the rioters, and prosecute offenders to the fullest extent of the law.

items.quote: I am pleased to report that yesterday, Federal agents arrested the suspected ringleader of the attack on the statue of the great Andrew Jackson in Washington, DC, and, in addition, hundreds more have been arrested.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: The radical view of American history is a web of lies: All perspective is removed, every virtue is obscured, every motive is twisted, every fact is distorted, and every flaw is magnified until the history is purged and the record is disfigured beyond all recognition.

items.meaning: 澄清事实／纠正错误说法
items.note: 原句 set history and history's record straight；保留实用内核而非照搬双宾语。
items.quote: Today we will set history and history's record straight.

items.note: 此处转喻整个人体现品格，不限身体外观。
items.quote: From head to toe, George Washington represented the strength, grace, and dignity of the American people.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: From a small volunteer force of citizen farmers, he created the Continental Army out of nothing and rallied them to stand against the most powerful military on Earth.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: Through 8 long years, through the brutal winter at Valley Forge, through setback after setback on the field of battle, he led those patriots to ultimate triumph.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: When the Army had dwindled to a few thousand men at Christmas of 1776, when defeat seemed absolutely certain, he took what remained of his forces on a daring nighttime crossing of the Delaware River.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: When called upon again, he presided over the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia and was unanimously elected our first President.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: When he stepped down after two terms, his former adversary King George called him "the greatest man of the age."

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: The first Republican President, he rose to high office from obscurity, based on a force and clarity of his antislavery convictions.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: Lincoln won the Civil War; he issued the Emancipation Proclamation; he led the passage of the 13th Amendment, abolishing slavery for all time; and ultimately, his determination to preserve our Nation and our Union cost him his life.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: He cleaned up corruption as police commissioner of New York City, then served as the Governor of New York, Vice President, and at 42 years old, became the youngest ever President of the United States.

items.note: 这是说话人的立场推论，不验证政治评价。
items.quote: No movement that seeks to dismantle these treasured American legacies can possibly have a love of America at its heart.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: The radical ideology attacking our country advances under the banner of social justice.

items.chunk: This is who we are. This is what we believe.
items.meaning: 这就是我们／我们的信念
items.note: 并列指代总结的结构，不当作独立政治口号。
items.quote: This is who we are. This is what we believe.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: But just as patriots did in centuries past, the American people will stand in their way.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: My fellow Americans, it is time to speak up loudly and strongly and powerfully and defend the integrity of our country.

items.note: 原句是孕育人物的国家叙事；不把人名列为chunk。
items.quote: We are the nation that gave rise to the Wright Brothers, the Tuskegee Airmen, Harriet Tubman, Clara Barton, Jesse Owens, George Patton—General George Patton—the great Louie Armstrong, Alan Shepard, Elvis Presley, and Mohammad Ali.

items.note: 与物理按住不同。
items.quote: And we will teach our children to know that they live in a land of legends, that nothing can stop them, and that no one can hold them down.

items.note: 按原句语境记录可替换槽位；候选待核，不以演讲出现推定日常高频。
items.quote: Uplifted by the titans of Mount Rushmore, we will find unity that no one expected; we will make strides that no one thought possible.
